# dokku_service_link (Data Source)

Links or unlinks a dokku service to an app

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dokku_service_link" "example" {
  app     = "my-app"
  service = "redis"
  name    = "my-redis"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) Name of the app to link the service to
- `name` (String) Name of the service instance
- `service` (String) Type of service to link (e.g. redis, postgres, mysql)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource's identity address.
